scope: Public HRS operation and experiment sources rechecked for an untouched station-to-vehicle full-loop holdout

sources.title: H2IQ Hour: Hydrogen Fuel Dispensing for Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicles
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy / National Renewable Energy Laboratory

reported_measurements.protocol: SAE J2601-5 MCF-HF-G H70 FM300 T40

sources.finding: The public presentation provides an important high-flow operating-range benchmark, but no downloadable synchronized pressure-temperature-flow trace, valve-state log or reuse terms for the underlying test.

sources.title: Supplementary Material for Modelling and operation strategy approaches for on-site Hydrogen Refuelling Stations
sources.publisher: Agencia Estatal Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas / Digital.CSIC
sources.reported_scope: Finite-state operational-flow diagrams and one-day/one-year simulation results for an on-site HRS configuration.
sources.finding: The public distribution contains a PDF and README, not measured station logger data. It is useful for model-structure comparison but cannot serve as an independent physical holdout.

sources.title: Four years of operational data for five hydrogen refueling stations
sources.reported_scope: Operator logs from four 350-bar bus stations summarized as fill amount, duration, average flow, daily profile, utilization and availability.
sources.finding: The record confirms real multi-station operational provenance but exposes aggregate indicators rather than synchronized pressure, temperature and mass-flow rows.

sources.title: Development, application and optimization of hydrogen refueling processes for railway vehicles
sources.publisher: DLR / FCH2RAIL / International Journal of Hydrogen Energy
sources.reported_scope: Reference-station and railway-vehicle measurements used to validate a refueling-process model.
sources.finding: The repository provides the open article and confirms measured station/vehicle behavior, but no machine-readable synchronized raw archive or reuse terms were linked.

sources.title: 35 MPa/70 MPa加氢机加注性能综合评价研究
sources.publisher: 石油和化工工业出版社 / 储能科学与技术
sources.finding: The article reports measured pressure, temperature and flow curves for 35 MPa and 70 MPa fueling, but the linked CSV downloads are only HTML table exports (initial/final summary tables), not synchronized time-series logger rows. Figure ZIPs are plots only; no raw trace, valve-state log or reuse terms were found.

sources.title: Representative Hydrogen Sampling at Hydrogen Refuelling Stations: Interplay of Sampling Strategy and Station Parameters
sources.reported_scope: ZBT test HRS sampling experiments using 35/70 MPa receptacles, a 244 L Type-IV sink, seven storage banks and logged dispenser/tank data.
sources.finding: The article says all dispenser and tank data were logged and its data-availability statement offers raw data on request; no public machine-readable trace or reuse terms were found. If released, this is a strong independent station-to-receptacle holdout candidate.

recommended_next_step.action: Request de-identified synchronized traces and reuse terms from the ZBT/MetHyTrucks authors, DOE/NREL HITRF, DLR/FCH2RAIL, Cal State LA and 3Emotion operators.
recommended_next_step.freeze_rule: If a raw file is received, quarantine it, hash it, freeze the model commit and scoring protocol before opening numerical outcomes.

claim_boundary: These sources support operating-range, real-station provenance and model-structure context. None closes the project's untouched full-loop external-validation gate; do not present an aggregate, table-only CSV, author-request-only source or simulation-only source as synchronized measured HRS validation.
